But land use change is also a large component of the story, accounting for about one-third of total historical CO2 emissions. Deforestation plays a major role here, but practices like draining wetlands also factor in. Exactly how much of our history of eliminating wetlands has contributed to warming is challenging to figure out. But thanks to new sources of data that measure emissions from today’s surviving wetlands, it’s possible to put a better number on it.

A new study led by Jevan Yu at MIT focuses on peatlands—environments like bogs and fens where organic matter accumulates into thick layers of material. Some 600 billion tons of carbon are held in these vast stores of peat, which is more than you can find in all the world’s living vegetation, the researchers note.

Because these areas are permanently inundated, any oxygen in the water is quickly used up, leaving the job of decaying all that organic matter to anaerobic bacteria that work much more slowly and don't digest everything. So instead of seeing organic carbon turning into the CO2 gas released by aerobic bacteria, in peatlands, a subset of it gradually turns into methane gas. Methane is an even more potent greenhouse gas than CO2 itself and ultimately gets oxidized into CO2. That means there’s a little trade-off from peatlands—most of the carbon they have is kept out of the atmosphere, but the carbon that does escape does so as methane.

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
 
Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application
  • Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour.

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       <\/div>
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       Position Overview<\/h3>\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \u00c2\u00a0<\/div>\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Agiloft's customers rely on our Ecosystem of System Integration (SI) partners to help them design, build and deliver solutions on the Agiloft platform. This role is designed to help our partners build robust capabilities within their organization and ultimately ensure our customers are realizing maximum value from the platform.<\/p>\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      As Partner Solution Architect, you'll support the partners as a technical advisor for partner-led implementations from kickoff through go-live. You'll guide SIs on architecture, integrations, data sync, and configuration. When something breaks, you'll figure out whether it's a configuration issue, an integration issue, or a real product defect, and get it to the right owner.<\/p>\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      You'll sit in the Partner Center of Excellence, the team responsible for making partner delivery repeatable and high quality. Our Partner Alliance Managers own the overall relationship with each partner and this role will be responsible for the successful technical outcome and capability development. You'll work daily with Sales, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, and Support, and you'll turn what you learn on each project into playbooks the whole ecosystem can use.<\/p>\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \u00c2\u00a0<\/div>\n<\/div>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Job Responsibilities<\/h4>
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      What you'll do<\/strong><\/p>\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Guide Partners to Go-live<\/strong><\/p>\n\nServe as the product & technical point of contact for SI partners and their customers during the implementation project and through go-live.\nAdvise on solution architecture, integration design, data synchronization, and configuration best practices across Agiloft's platform: core CLM, procurement and source-to-pay workflows, ERP sync (such as SAP S\/4HANA), APIs and MCP-based orchestration, and AI and analytics capabilities.\nHelp partners separate out-of-the-box capability from custom implementation work so each fix lands with the right owner.\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Own the Technical Escalation Path<\/strong><\/p>\n\nAct as the Tier 3 technical resource for partner-led projects.\nTriage and reproduce issues, document them clearly, and log true defects and enhancement requests to Product and Engineering in Jira.\nJoin partner and customer working sessions when a blocker needs Agiloft in the room.\nHand accounts off cleanly to Support at transition, with documented configuration and open items.\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Enable the Ecosystem<\/strong><\/p>\n\nBuild and deliver partner training, webinars, and learning content with Product and go-to-market teams.\nWork with Product and Engineering to stand up and maintain partner sandboxes, test environments, and knowledge base access.\nSupport the change management and promote the value of monthly releases into the partner ecosystem.\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Build the Playbook<\/strong><\/p>\n\nCreate and maintain implementation playbooks, a known-issue library, escalation runbooks, and environment setup guides.\nFeed patterns from real projects back into enablement, documentation, and the product roadmap.\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      What Success Looks Like in Year One<\/strong><\/p>\n\nPartner-led go-lives land on schedule, with fewer slipping because of unresolved technical blockers.\nTechnical escalations from partners reach a clear owner quickly, with reproducible detail, and resolve faster.\nProduct and Engineering receive structured, prioritized signal from partner projects instead of ad hoc pulls.\nProduct and Engineering receive a steady, well-documented stream of implementation feedback that shapes the roadmap.\nA working go-live toolkit exists and partners actually use it: playbooks, known-issue library, runbooks, reference architectures, and environment guides.\nSupport inherits cleaner, better-documented accounts at handoff.\nTarget metrics: e.g. on-time go-live rate, median time to resolve partner escalations, escalations per quarter, training events delivered.\nOther duties as assigned.\n\n<\/div>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Required Qualifications<\/h4>
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      What you'll bring<\/strong><\/p>\n\n5+ years in a technical, customer- or partner-facing implementation role: solution architecture, professional services, implementation or integration consulting, or sales engineering with post-sale delivery.\nAgiloft certification, or relevant platform certifications (Salesforce, SAP, cloud).\nHands-on experience designing and troubleshooting enterprise integrations including REST APIs, webhooks, authentication patterns (OAuth, JWT), and data sync between systems of record.\nWorking knowledge of the systems CLM connects to, such as Salesforce, ERP (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite), and Procurement relevant ISVs\nStrong troubleshooting instincts. You can isolate whether an issue is configuration, integration, or product defect, and explain it precisely to engineers and executives alike.\nSolution design skills: you can translate business requirements into a technical design and explain the trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.\nExperience guiding external partners or customers while working across Product, Engineering, and Support.\nExposure to AI-enabled workflows, LLM tooling, or MCP-based integrations.\nA builder's habit of turning one-off fixes into reusable documentation and process.\n\n<\/div>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Preferred Qualifications<\/h4>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Nice to have<\/strong><\/p>\n\nIntegration middleware experience: Workato, MuleSoft, or Boomi.\nBackground in CLM, procurement or source-to-pay, CPQ, or related enterprise workflow platforms; hands-on experience implementing a CLM platform is a strong plus.\nPrior work at or alongside SI and consulting partners.\nExposure to ISV\/managed-package delivery, versioning, and enterprise deployment considerations.\nPrior experience working directly with or inside SI or consulting partners.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Reports to:<\/strong> Chris Stella, VP Growth<\/p>\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  About Lifeforce<\/strong><\/p>\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  We are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health. No longer satisfied with the reactive, fragmented care offered by the traditional healthcare system, millions of people are taking a more proactive approach. They want to understand how their bodies work, take control of how they feel and perform, and invest in living longer, healthier lives. Lifeforce is leading this shift as the world's largest longevity medicine program.<\/p>\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Founded alongside clinical and scientific leaders from Cleveland Clinic, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School, Lifeforce brings together the diagnostics, expertise, and treatments people need to understand and optimize their health, both today and for decades to come. Our comprehensive program combines advanced diagnostics, expert clinicians, dedicated health coaches, and personalized supplement, pharmaceutical, and lifestyle protocols. All delivered from home, at the price of a gym membership.<\/p>\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Overview<\/strong><\/p>\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Lifeforce is hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own every message a lead or member gets from us after the first click. You'll run email, SMS, push, and in-app messaging across the full journey: turning leads into members, getting new members through their first diagnostics and clinician visit, keeping members engaged with their protocols, and bringing back the ones who drift.<\/p>\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  This is a hands-on role. You will build the journeys, write and test the messages, set up the segments, and read the results yourself. You'll use AI tools to move faster on copy, personalization, and analysis, and you'll build a lifecycle program that scales as our membership, clinician network, and Ultimate Longevity Center (ULC) locations grow.<\/p>\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  You'll work closely with growth, product, clinical, coaching, and member experience teams. Paid acquisition brings people to the door. You make sure they walk in, stay, and get results.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key Responsibilities<\/h4>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Lead Nurture & Conversion<\/strong><\/p>\n\nBuild and run nurture journeys that turn leads from paid, organic, and referral channels into members.\nWork with the growth team to match messaging to the ads, landing pages, and offers that brought each lead in.\nTest offers, timing, and content to raise lead-to-member conversion.\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Onboarding & Activation<\/strong><\/p>\n\nOwn the new-member journey from sign-up through first lab draw, results review, and first clinician and coach visits.\nCut drop-off at each step by finding where members get stuck and fixing it with clear, timely messages.\nPartner with member experience and operations so messages match what members actually see and do.\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Retention, Engagement & Win-Back<\/strong><\/p>\n\nBuild programs that keep members engaged with their protocols, follow-up diagnostics, and coaching.\nDrive adoption of supplements, prescriptions, and other offerings where they fit a member's plan.\nRun churn-prevention, win-back, and referral programs.\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Segmentation, Testing & Analytics<\/strong><\/p>\n\nBuild segments and triggers from member behavior, lifecycle stage, and program data.\nRun a steady testing roadmap across subject lines, content, channels, timing, and offers.\nOwn lifecycle reporting: conversion, activation, retention, churn, and revenue by journey.\nUse AI tools like Claude to draft and personalize content, analyze results, and speed up production.\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Platform & Compliance<\/strong><\/p>\n\nOwn our lifecycle platform setup, data flows, templates, and deliverability.\nWork with clinical and compliance teams to keep every message accurate and compliant with HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM.\nDocument journeys and processes so the program can scale without adding headcount.\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Role Description<\/h2>\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  As an<\/span>\u00c2\u00a0Offensive Security Engineer<\/span> within Dropbox Security, you will investigate how attackers could compromise our products and infrastructure, including AI-enabled applications and agentic systems. You will help identify meaningful attack paths and improve the controls intended to prevent, detect or contain them.<\/span><\/p>\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  This is a hands-on offensive security and threat research role with broad scope and meaningful impact. You will apply practical AI security knowledge alongside broader offensive security skills across applications, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems. Working closely with experienced researchers and partners across Product Security, Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Privacy, and engineering, you will help translate technical findings into clear business risk, recommend practical improvements, and validate their effectiveness through retesting. Sound judgment, clear communication, responsible execution, and ownership of your work are essential to the role. You will contribute to the Red Team\u00e2\u0080\u0099s tools, research methods, and testing practices while developing your own areas of expertise, investigating emerging technologies, and helping advance Dropbox\u00e2\u0080\u0099s offensive security capabilities.
